verdict.rationale: Evidence shows some desktop-interface features (Snap layouts, Windows Hello, Copilot) that a new user might learn, but there is no evidence of actual guided installation tutorials for switchers—the cited docs are developer/API documentation (WinUI, Store submission) rather than end-user onboarding guides. Community evidence even highlights setup friction (forced Microsoft account sign-in, hidden local-account workaround) contradicting a smooth guided experience.
